newsitem.title: USA: AMR Corp in talks for wide-body aircraft.
newsitem.headline: AMR Corp in talks for wide-body aircraft.

text.p: AMR Corp is in talks with airplane manufacturers to purchase wide-body aircraft, chief financial officer Gerard Arpey said Wednesday.

"We are actively engaged in talks for wide-body airplanes," Arpey said during a teleconference with reporters. "We have a pressing need for wide-body aircraft beginning in the summer of 1998," he said.
The parent of American Airlines said it is also considering purchasing smaller, regional planes.
"Our most pressing need is wide-body aircraft, but there's no guarantee that's the first thing we do," Arpey said.
Arpey did not detail the timing or size of a possible aircraft order.
